name: Tuấn
description: Rounded face with slightly chubby cheeks, short straight black hair with a small natural cowlick at the front, warm beige skin tone, slim-average build, default expression is a tired-but-endearing puzzled look with slightly droopy eyes and a small open mouth
outfit: Solid mint-green crew-neck T-shirt (no logos, no text), dark navy blue jogger pants, white socks with light grey slip-on sneakers
personality: Well-meaning but disorganised young adult who impulse-buys and forgets things in the fridge — relatable and gently comedic
